name: jelly-oidc
install: [ ! -d '/agent/repos/jelly-oidc' ] || cd '/agent/repos/jelly-oidc' || exit $?; command -v docker >/dev/null || sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq docker.io docker-compose-v2; command -v dotnet >/dev/null || curl -fsSL https://dot.net/v1/dotnet-install.sh | bash /dev/stdin --channel 9.0 --install-dir "$HOME/.dotnet" && ln -sf "$HOME/.dotnet/dotnet" /usr/local/bin/dotnet; export PATH="$HOME/.dotnet:$PATH"; bash scripts/build-plugin.sh; sudo docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml pull
start: [ ! -d '/agent/repos/jelly-oidc' ] || cd '/agent/repos/jelly-oidc' || exit $?; bash scripts/build-plugin.sh; sudo docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml up -d; for i in $(seq 1 90); do curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8096/health >/dev/null && break; sleep 2; done
